notes: New record: no OVH rise file exists in dossier/compute, and this is the range that actually sells while Kimsufi does not. It also corrects a reading that the whole OVH eco catalogue is exhausted: nineteen of twenty-six KS plan codes are unavailable on this date and the surviving stock is Asia-Pacific and North American, while RISE-1 is available in seven European and North American datacenters. The installation fee is the part a price comparison usually drops: on monthly billing RISE-1 costs EUR 113.98 in the first month and EUR 56.99 after, so a two-month trial costs twice the headline. Traffic is null because the catalogue carries a port rate and no volume term, and the OVH dedicated pages I read did not restate an unlimited allowance for this range.
